notes.title: New Enemies, Hazards, Character Skins and Environments!
notes.content: Hey what up guys! We're excited to announce that we have added a new enemy (the Suicide Bomber) a new hazard (Explosive Barrel) 3 new character skins to choose from and 3 new environments! Stay tuned for the multiplayer update!
